name: spinner
description: Animations and a companion pet while the model works: a mascot beside the spinner, a scene above the prompt (a shoot-em-up, Clawd, pixel homages and more), a finale and a pet that levels up, in fourteen themes

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: The animations' look: clawd (Claude's mascot), thunder (a shoot-em-up), chomp, sparky, bluecat, nyan (pixel homages), cat, bunny, sakura, mecha, neon, dino, ocean, matrix, or random for a new one each session. /spinner <theme> switches it live

stage.title: Animation band
stage.description: A two-row animated scene above the prompt while the model works (/spinner stage off|on overrides it)

celebrate.title: Finale
celebrate.description: A short finale in the band when a turn ends: confetti and the time it took, or a sad face when interrupted

companion.title: Companion
companion.description: A pet in a row above the prompt: it shows what the model is doing (the tool running, a permission waiting), stays between turns, levels up as turns finish, and a click or /spinner pet pats it (/spinner companion off|on overrides it)

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of /spinner's replies and the finale's label; auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale
